original_source.archive_encoding: Concatenate archive_parts in listed order; bytes equal the original supplied PDF.

repository_pdf.scope: Original reference file outside the frozen Web package; not served or copied to the publication inventory.

normalizations: Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components (callout strip, warning lockup, reference figure, App download, warranty lead and sections).
Print line breaks: a line the print ended while the next word would still have fitted is kept as a line break; every other line end is a wrap (logged in source/en/coverage.json).
Print weights: bold and semibold runs stay strong; headings keep print case and the print's two subheading sizes.
Lists: numbered and bullet print items become ordered or unordered lists; asterisk notes and FCC dash lines stay as printed lines.
Tables keep the print's merged cells (row and column spans); the specification table has no header row, as printed.
Ligatures are expanded; two print-split words are rejoined (consump-/tion, approxi/mately).
Five visible lines absent from the PDF text layer are restored from source/text-recovery.json.
Artwork words stay in the reviewed figure crops; the figures carry no visible caption.

validation_boundary.build_py_check: Existing JE-1000F/US fixture regression only; does not validate JA-TS02A or register it in phase2.
native_body: shared Manual IR validation and replay

source_authority: operator-supplied original PDF; native visible English content; no translation or product adaptation
